newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Handlowy to set IPO price range by May 23.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Handlowy to set IPO price range by May 23.

text.p: The price range for Poland's Bank Handlowy SA offered in the individual and institutional tranches will be set by May 23 and the final price would be set by June 17, the bank said in its issue prospectus on Monday.
It said in the individual investor tranche the shares would be alloted at a special bourse session on June 21.

It said employees would get the shares at a par value of four zlotys per share and in the stable investor tranche the price would be set in negotiations with the investors and the shares could be alloted by the end of the year.
Stable investors would be obliged not to sell the shares for three year, the bank said.
The bank said individual investors would get a discount of either five or three percent, depending whether they order the shares in earlier or later subscription period.

It also said individual investors who do not sell shares for a year, would be entitled to buy one share for each 10 shares held at half the market price. It said the 2,372,500 premium shares would come from stable investor tranche.
It said in the institutional investor tranche Polish investors would be offered shares and foreign investors shares or Global Depository Receipts (GDRs). No of Shares Offered: 61,750,000
